# Third-Party Dependencies

Misuc links against the following third-party libraries. All are free/open-source
and redistributable. Full versions of each license are shipped by the distro
packages; see the links below.

| Library            | Version  | License                                  | Used for                                       |
|--------------------|----------|------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------|
| libpipewire-0.3    | 1.0.x    | MIT (see pipewire COPYING)               | Real-time audio I/O backend                     |
| libasound (ALSA)   | 1.2.x    | LGPL-2.1                                 | Diagnostics & non-PipeWire device probing       |
| libsndfile         | 1.2.x    | LGPL-2.1                                 | Audio file import/decode                       |
| Qt 6 (Widgets)     | 6.4.x    | LGPL-3.0 / GPL-3.0 (dual)                | User interface shell                            |
| GNU libstdc++      | GCC 13   | GPL-3.0 with runtime exception           | Standard C++ library                           |

No proprietary assets are bundled.
